locations.note: In 1984 Ord Salomon investigates a dead author's hidden manuscript from his base in Gothenburg, choosing destinations from a map of the city.
The author Bergwall died on a boat off the island of Fardo, where an import/export company, his working cabin, a church and wartime bunkers are part of the investigation.

routes.name: Ord Salomon
routes.note: From Gothenburg to the island of Fardo.
